Name: Spine
Description: This will create a IK FK Spine System

attrs.Help_string: What this block does: This will create a IK FK Spine System. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4). Breath: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. OrientToWorld: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. SetGameParent: set the node/object name this block should use. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Spine_Inv_Jnt, Spine_F_Jnt.
